ai.title: Pitched 2 ideas to PM Modi in 90 seconds on Chennai Metro: Who is AI startup founder Tejas Sudarshan & what did he propose?
ai.description: Chennai-based startup founder Tejas Parthasarathi Sudarshan pitched two artificial intelligence ideas to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a Chennai Metro journey, getting around 90 seconds to present his proposals. The Winsen Labs founder suggested connecting students with real-world government projects and creating a unified AI-powered platform to simplify access to public services. He was among 17 startup founders shortlisted by SPI Chennai for the interaction.
ai.title_cn: 我在90秒内向莫迪总理提出了两个关于金奈地铁项目的建议：谁是这家人工智能初创公司的创始人Tejas Sudarshan？他提出了什么计划？
ai.description_cn: 位于钦奈的初创公司创始人Tejas Parthasarathi Sudarshan在参观钦奈地铁时，向总理纳伦德拉·莫迪提出了两个关于人工智能的想法。他只有大约90秒的时间来展示自己的提案。Winsen Labs的创始人建议将学生与实际的政府项目联系起来，并创建一个由人工智能驱动的平台，以简化公众服务的获取流程。他是SPI钦奈评选出的17位受邀参与交流的初创公司创始人之一。
